reason: My udhaar diary has worked for years and I trust it more than any phone. I am not handing my customers' khata to a WhatsApp robot because someone promises it will understand my Hindi.
objection: Will it understand my Hindi, my regional words and my item names? One wrong card or a missed udhaar entry and I lose money and a customer's trust, and then I have to check everything against my diary anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A trial on my own real orders, with someone showing me it gets my item names and regional words right, while I keep writing my diary alongside it for a few months.
